title: Applications Of Surface Tension
definition: Surface tension is the elastic tendency of a fluid surface which makes it acquire the least possible surface area, driven by the inward cohesive forces of liquid molecules.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims General Science via practical phenomena (droplets, capillary action, cleansing action of soaps) and in Mains GS-3 (Science and Technology applications in industry, agriculture, and medicine).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Applications Of Surface Tension.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
